title: Giving Up a Granite Ridge Season Pass for Good
content:
## The request this facility answers

A household asks to give a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass up for good, and the charge the collective keeps is placed on the pass account. The charge retained when a pass is given up is worked out only after the pass account carries an application of resort credit against the amount it still shows to collect. The charge is the figure the collective's basis for a retained charge produces; the agent works it out from the records and the published terms and passes it in.

## The business effect

The pass record moves to the given-up state, is stamped with today as the last date it admitted the holder and with the reason the household gives, the charge kept is booked on the pass account dated today, and the amount still to be collected rises by that charge, so the pass stops admitting the holder from that moment.

## How it is invoked

Giving the household's own holding up is their own act. The agent unlocks the hidden tool `give_up_season_pass_8c1a0eca` and hands it over, and it is run by the customer themselves.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pass_id` | the reference number of the season pass record being given up | an identifier, as returned by the season pass lookup |
| `protection_plan_id` | the reference number of the protection plan record the collective checks the surrender against | an identifier, as returned by the protection plan lookup; it is recorded with the surrender and the plan itself is left untouched |
| `cancellation_reason` | why the household is giving the pass up, in the collective's own labels | one of the six values below |
| `retained_charge_usd` | the charge the collective keeps and places on the pass account for the surrender | a fixed-format figure in USD to 2 decimal places, never negative and booked at exactly the figure given |

The complete set of values `cancellation_reason` takes:

- `none` — no reason is being recorded at all
- `guest_request` — the household simply no longer wants the pass
- `medical` — the holder has been told they may not ski
- `relocation` — the household has moved permanently away from the region
- `employment_loss` — the household has lost the employment the pass was bought on
- `resort_closure` — the collective itself has stopped running the season

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence carrying the new pass account entry reference, a string beginning `pgup_`, the pass record reference, the state the pass record now stands in, the reason recorded, the charge kept in USD to 2 decimal places and the amount still to be collected on that pass account afterwards, also in USD to 2 decimal places. The presence of that entry reference is what indicates the surrender was recorded.
